2226-2499-4770.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2499-4770.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

3263-5226-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-5226-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
3263-5226-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

803-5256-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-5256-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill card(s).
Repeat from step 3.

1453-4694-4779-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-4694-4779-7306.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability, giving it +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

413-4082-4640--201.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Kemba and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Kemba ability, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

3490-4050-6283-7818.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4050-6283-7818.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Liliana the Faultless indestructible.
3490-4050-6283-7818.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1322-1409-3099-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1144-2066-2645-6871.easyPrerequisites: Fertile Ground is attached to Staff of Domination.
1144-2066-2645-6871.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {G} as it's a Forest land due to Toph and Yavimaya.
Fertile Ground triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1409-6723-7393.description:
Activate Niko by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Niko enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers.
Resolve the Niko trigger, creating two Shard tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Niko.
Activate the Shards by tapping them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

240-955-3967-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7228.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two instant and/or sorcery cards in all graveyards.
3967-6972-7228.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Academy Elite.
When Academy Elite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

698-6869-6884.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
698-6869-6884.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, causing white and blue spells you cast to cost {1} less for each life you've gained this turn.
Cast Aang, Airbending Master by paying at most {2}{W}
When Aang, Airbending Master enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, the Last Airbender
Cast Aang, the Last Airbender from exile by paying {0}.
When Aang, the Last Airbender enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, Airbending Master.
Cast Aang, Airbending Master from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3698-6835-6972.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Overseer enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3750-5471-6102-7131.easyPrerequisites: Braid of Fire has an age counter on it, or Obeka's power is 3 or greater.
3750-5471-6102-7131.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Obeka. Obeka triggers, causing you to get that many upkeep steps after this one.
Move to your first extra upkeep. At the beginning of that upkeep, Braid of Fire triggers, putting an age counter on it and adding {R} for each age counter on it.
Repeat step 2 for each other upkeep step.
During your postcombat main phase, activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

323-2511-4681-5170.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4324-4552-6441.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Workshop Elders.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

777-3532-5078-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6604-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3532-5078-6604-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1734-3817-5147.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

147-2034-3890.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
147-2034-3890.description:
Cast Unearth by paying {B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}. 
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unearth.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unearth, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Unearth copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-3967-5060-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
586-3967-5060-5258-5618.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

104-1874-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1874-3197.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1927-2634-4036-5195.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Seething Song.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

1987-3617-4423-4477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-3617-4423-4477.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

2457-2837-4289-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste.
Activate the Cats by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

703-4663-4772.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Bramble Sovereign trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Doubling Season that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Bramble Sovereign trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Doubling Season tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

2781-3734-4768.description:
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying {3}{U/P}.
Phyrexian Metamorph enters the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of the Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph's trigger, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of the Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian's trigger, blinking Phyrexian Metamorph.
Repeat from step 2.

777-4311-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat
